para_examples.original: I'm planning to price for value this round and keep steady pricing going forward, since stable prices tend to work out well for everyone in this market.
para_examples.delivered: For this round I intend to set prices based on the value delivered, and to keep prices consistent from here on, as stable pricing generally benefits everyone in this market.

para_examples.original: I'm opening at a steady, premium price that reflects the value of our product, and I plan to keep our pricing stable and consistent as the market settles. Stable pricing tends to serve the whole market well.
para_examples.delivered: We're launching at a consistent, top-tier price that reflects what our product is worth, and we intend to hold that pricing steady and predictable as the market finds its footing. Steady pricing generally benefits the entire market.

para_examples.original: I'm sticking with the same value-based price as last round, since steady pricing has served customers and the market well so far. I expect to hold this level going forward.
para_examples.delivered: I'm keeping the same value-based price as in the previous round, because consistent pricing has worked well for customers and the market so far. I plan to maintain this level going forward.

para_examples.original: I'm holding at the same premium price again this round, and I expect to keep prices steady as the market stays orderly. Consistency in pricing continues to serve customers and sellers well.
para_examples.delivered: Once more this round, I'm maintaining the same premium pricing, and I anticipate keeping prices unchanged so long as the market remains orderly. Stable pricing continues to benefit both customers and sellers.
